age_limit.details: Project Research Scientist I: Maximum age limit is 35 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be as per Central Govt. norms. Project Technical Support-III: Maximum age limit is 30 years. Age relaxation for SC/ST/OBC candidates will be as per Central Govt. norms.

qualification.education_qualification: Post graduate degrees in Pharmacy/Life sciences/Biotechnology for Scientist; 12th with Diploma (MLT/DMLT) or Graduate in Life Sciences or Post Graduate in Life Sciences for Technical Support.
qualification.details: Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical): Post graduate degrees in Pharmacy/Life sciences/Biotechnology. Preference will be given to candidates having at least 1 year of research experience in protein isolation from mammalian/bacterial samples, LC-MS-based omics studies, and characterization. Project Technical Support-III: 12th in science + Diploma (MLT/DMLT) with 5 years of experience in a medical/research laboratory. Three-year graduate degree in the Life sciences field with two years of experience in a medical/research laboratory. Post graduates (PG) degree in Life sciences without professional experience. Desirable: Experience in in vitro anti-TB assays, cell culture handling, and in vivo animal experiments, preferably with knowledge of handling Mycobacterium tuberculosis cultures.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for NIPER Hajipur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-09-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for NIPER Hajipur Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 08-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NIPER Hajipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the NIPER Hajipur Recruitment 2026 is 08 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the post names for which NIPER Hajipur is recruiting?
faq.answer: NIPER Hajipur is recruiting for the posts of Project Research Scientist-I (Non-Medical) and Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is via email.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Project Research Scientist-I post?
faq.answer: The salary for the Project Research Scientist-I post is Rs. 56,000.00 + 10% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum qualification for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification for the Project Technical Support-III post is 12th pass in science with a Diploma (MLT/DMLT).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for Project Technical Support-III?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Project Technical Support-III is 30 years, with age relaxation applicable for SC/ST/OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process involves CV screening followed by an interview, which can be conducted in physical or online mode.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF link will be available in the "Important Links" section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. Who can I contact for queries regarding the recruitment?
faq.answer: For queries, you can contact the Principal Investigator at [email protected].
